sentences.en: He maintained that all occupations should be open to women.
sentences.zh: 他坚持认为所有职业都应该向女性开放。

sentences.en: Don't discriminate against people based on nationality, gender, or occupation.
sentences.zh: 不要因为国籍、性别或职业而歧视他人。

sentences.en: He is engaged in an occupation of his own choice.
sentences.zh: 他从事着自己选择的职业。
